title: Shariah profile v0.1 — synthetic demo rule pack (UNCERTIFIED)
description: Synthetic demo rule pack: not a fatwa / not certified / not production advice. Illustrative category-level screening only; MCC mappings are synthetic demo assignments. A certified v1.0 pack would carry scholar-reviewed rule coverage, AAOIFI standard citations in each standards_ref, and a scholar signature over this pack's hash.

rules.title: Gambling merchant category
rules.description: The merchant category code identifies a gambling, betting, lottery, or casino merchant. Maysir (gambling) is prohibited.

rules.title: Gambling exposure in merchant attributes
rules.description: Merchant attribute data flags gambling activity (e.g. a casino operation inside a hotel). Maysir (gambling) is prohibited even when the primary merchant category is permissible.

rules.title: Alcohol merchant category
rules.description: The merchant category code identifies a bar, tavern, nightclub, or package store selling intoxicants. Intoxicants are prohibited.

rules.title: Intoxicant exposure in merchant attributes
rules.description: Merchant attribute data flags alcohol or other intoxicant sales as a material line of business.

rules.title: Interest-bearing cash advance category
rules.description: The merchant category code identifies a cash-disbursement facility that operates on interest-bearing credit (synthetic demo mapping). Riba (interest) is prohibited.

rules.title: Interest-bearing credit in merchant attributes
rules.description: Merchant attribute data flags interest-bearing credit products. Riba (interest) is prohibited.

rules.title: Speculative derivative exposure
rules.description: Merchant or instrument attribute data flags speculative derivatives. Gharar (excessive uncertainty) requires human review rather than automated approval.

rules.title: Mixed impermissible revenue share above demo threshold
rules.description: Screening data reports an impermissible revenue share at or above the synthetic demo threshold of 5%. The threshold is illustrative, not a certified screening standard; the case is routed to human review.
